The doubling off the low is NOT SONATA run-up - the enrollment-completion release itself traded down 2.6% on the day and the stock is flat-to-lower versus its late-June level, so the Q1 2027 readout is a genuinely forward, genuinely unpriced-at-the-margin binary with roughly +50% to +200% of re-derived upside still remaining against a ~$1.40 ex-HCM floor. The waterfall is clean (no preferred stack, $66M total liabilities, no external manager), so unlike FIP the derived numerator survives provenance. What holds this at WATCH rather than ACTIVE is event quality and timing, not harvest: it clears only Bloom G2 (a company-committed date, no counterparty and no disclosed unpriced figure), it is a coin-flip clinical print in an indication where SGLT mechanism is plausible but unprecedented for a symptom endpoint against Camzyos/aficamten, and $170M of Q1 cash against heavy burn makes a dilutive raise before the print highly likely - which erodes the numerator in exactly the success case being underwritten.
